description:
This charming three-bedroom home, with no forward chain,  is ideally located in a central area with excellent access to local shops, amenities, and transport links. To the front of the property, a paved courtyard welcomes you into a bright, airy hallway with attractive laminate flooring.

At the front of the house is a spacious main living room featuring a large bay window, combining tasteful modern touches with lovely retained period features — the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining. Further along the hallway, under-stair storage has been cleverly integrated, and a half-glazed door provides access to the rear garden.

The dining room is a bright and modern space with a side-facing window and laminate flooring, ideal for family meals or entertaining. The adjoining kitchen is well-appointed with a built-in oven and hob, generous worktop space, and room for appliances. A door from the kitchen leads out into the rear garden.

Upstairs, the landing leads to the spacious main bedroom at the front of the property, which includes a built-in wardrobe and ample space for additional furniture. The family bathroom is finished to a high standard with a modern suite, shower over bath, and stylish grey tiling.

Two further well-sized bedrooms are situated at the rear, both retaining attractive period fireplaces and one with built-in storage. The rear garden includes a fenced patio and a lawned area with great potential to create a peaceful outdoor retreat.

This well-presented property is ready to move into and offers a rare blend of character and convenience. Early viewing is highly recommended.

Material Information • Tenure: Freehold • Council Tax: Band B • Electricity: Mains Supply • Heating: Gas• Water Supply: Mains supply • Sewage: Mains Supply • Broadband: Standard, Superfast and Ultrafast Fibre are all available in this area • Parking: On Street • Mobile: Ofcom official website checker states that EE, Vodafone, O2 and Three available in the area • Flood Risk: Low risk
